SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices in Panipat as a direct factory, not a marketplace reseller. We have built modular steel cabins since 2009 and completed 500+ projects across India. Units for Panipat are fabricated at our Greater Noida works and sent by road down NH-44 to sites across the city, the HSIIDC industrial estate on Refinery Road, the Sector 25 and 29 HUDA belt, and the Samalkha fabrication zone. At about 155–180 km, most Panipat orders reach the site in just 2–3 days once the build is ready — one of our shortest hauls.

A container office is a factory-built steel cabin that arrives finished and ready to use. It gives you a clean, lockable, weather-proof workspace without the time, cost, and mess of on-site civil construction. For a city that runs on textiles and home furnishing — blankets, carpets, rugs, bed linen, and the export houses that ship them — plus engineering and packaging units in HSIIDC, warehousing along the GT Road corridor, and large project sites near the Panipat refinery belt, a container office is the fastest way to put a site office, admin cabin, or security post exactly where the work is.

How we build our container offices

Every unit starts with a mild steel frame in IS 2062 structural steel, welded and treated to resist rust through Panipat's hot summers and cold, foggy winters. The base sits on a channel frame so the cabin stays off wet or dusty ground. Walls use insulated PUF sandwich panels, or cement board with rockwool, so the inside stays comfortable in both the May heat and the January cold. The roof is profiled GI sheet with a slope for rain runoff. Flooring is marine ply with vinyl for office use, or chequered MS plate for heavy gate and store cabins that take constant foot traffic. A standard fit-out covers electrical wiring with switches, points, LED lights and a distribution board, powder-coated windows with grille and shutter, and a steel or laminated door with a lock. We add air-conditioning, toilets with plumbing, pantry units, and internal partitions when a site needs them.

Common sizes for Panipat sites

Popular configurations are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft for a single supervisor, guard, or weighbridge cabin, 20×8 ft (the standard shipping-container footprint) for a site office that seats a small team, and 40×8 ft for larger project offices with two or three rooms. We also fabricate to custom dimensions, and stack units in double-decker form where ground space is tight — a common request on packed HUDA industrial plots and mill yards. If you are unsure of the size, tell us the headcount and how the cabin will be used and we will suggest a layout that fits your plot.

Where they are used around Panipat

Buyers in the Panipat region use our cabins as admin and billing offices for textile and home-furnishing units, supervisor and admin cabins inside engineering and packaging plants in the HSIIDC estate (132103) and the Sector 25 and 29 HUDA belt, gate and security cabins for export warehouses on the GT Road, weighbridge and store cabins for logistics yards, construction and maintenance site offices for large project grounds near the refinery belt, and fabrication-shop offices around Samalkha (132101). For teams setting up on raw ground, we build container site offices for project grounds with heavier flooring and extra power points for tools and equipment.

Customization and price factors

Because every unit is made to order, the price in Panipat depends on the size, the panel type (PUF costs more than cement board but insulates far better through the harsh winters), the flooring, and add-ons like air-conditioning, a toilet, a pantry, or extra electrical load for machines. Colour, branding, window and door count, and internal partitions are all your choice. We confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion rather than showing a fixed sticker price that would not match your actual build — that way you pay for the cabin you need, not a template. Compare our specifications against any marketplace listing: the difference is that you are dealing with the factory that welds the frame, not an agent forwarding your enquiry to someone else.

Delivery, warranty, and certifications

Delivery to Panipat is charged at ₹3,000 where applicable, with road transit of about 2–3 days once the unit is ready — Panipat is close to our Greater Noida factory, so it is one of our quicker deliveries. We also offer a 7-day return window, with return shipping paid by the customer. SAMAN Portable operates under ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and is registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our container offices carry a 5-year structural frame and base warranty, 1–2 years on finishing, and a 20–25 year engineered service life for the steel structure — real, verifiable credentials that a marketplace listing cannot show you.

Why buy from SAMAN

Search for a container office on a directory and you get a page of resellers competing on the same stock photos. Enquire with SAMAN and you reach the manufacturer directly — honest specifications, real size options, transparent price factors, and one point of accountability from fabrication to dispatch. See our container office manufacturing line to understand the standards we build to, and our work across the northern belt — container offices we deliver across Delhi, container offices across the Meerut belt, and container offices reaching Chandigarh — shows the same build quality reaches every Haryana site.

Frequently asked questions

Do you deliver container offices to Panipat and the HSIIDC industrial estate?
Yes. We manufacture at our Greater Noida factory and dispatch by road down NH-44 to Panipat city (132103), the HSIIDC industrial estate and Sector 25 and 29 HUDA belt (132103), and the Samalkha zone (132101). Transit is usually 2–3 days once the unit is built, with delivery charged at ₹3,000 where applicable.

What container office sizes suit Panipat textile and warehouse units?
Common sizes are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft cabins, 20×8 ft site offices, and 40×8 ft project offices. We also build custom dimensions and double-decker units for packed HUDA plots and mill yards.

What does a container office cost in Panipat?
Price depends on size, panel type, flooring, and add-ons like AC or a toilet. Since every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion so the figure matches your exact build.

Can the cabin be customised for textile units, warehouses, and project sites?
Yes. We add AC, toilets, pantries, partitions, extra power points, and heavier flooring for gate or store use, and we match the layout, colour, and window and door count to your site.

Talk to the manufacturer. For container offices anywhere in the Panipat region, call our North zone team on +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details for a made-to-order quote.
